name: Georgia
dueDateNotes: Georgia follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Georgia applies a single flat 4.99% rate to your federal AGI after the standard deduction ($15,000 single / $30,000 joint for 2026).
uniqueFacts: Georgia cut its flat income tax rate to 4.99% for 2026 under HB 463 (signed May 2026), down from the previously scheduled 5.19%.
Georgia's standard deduction is $15,000 for single filers and $30,000 for married couples filing jointly in 2026.
For 2026 through 2028, Georgia lets you exclude up to $1,750 each of tip income and overtime pay from your taxable income.
